user.title: Connect Flipdot
user.description: Address of the fluepboard on the network. The display needs no authentication.

error.cannot_connect: The display does not respond. Check address and network.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the framebuffer is read, for the preview and foreign content detection.
data_description.rotation_interval: Default duration per rotation page unless the page defines its own.

send_text.name: Show text
send_text.description: Writes text to the display. In device mode the board renders itself, in compose mode Home Assistant builds the image and can centre and wrap.

device_id.name: Display
device_id.description: Which Flipdot display to target. Applies to all if omitted.

font.description: Short font name, e.g. DejaVuSans12bw_bwfont or builtin5x7.

mode.name: Render mode
mode.description: device = the board renders, compose = Home Assistant builds the image.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon drawn left of the text.

clear.description: Clear the display first. Otherwise remnants of the previous content stay visible.

duration.description: How long the message stays before the display returns to normal operation.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Higher priority replaces a running message.

destination_sign.name: Destination sign
destination_sign.description: Makes the display look like the destination sign on a bus or tram: line number in a box on the left, destination next to it, and the stop it runs via smaller underneath.

device_id.name: Display
device_id.description: Which Flipdot display to target. Applies to all if omitted.

line_number.name: Line number
line_number.description: Shown in the box on the left. Without it there is no box.

destination.name: Destination
destination.description: The big line, usually the final stop.

via.name: Via
via.description: Intermediate stop, smaller on the second line. Without it the sign stays single-line.

via_prefix.name: Via prefix
via_prefix.description: Placed in front of the intermediate stop. Leave empty to show the stop on its own.

box.name: Box
box.description: outline draws a frame, filled punches the number out of a solid block, none leaves the number standing free.

font.name: Font
font.description: Short font name, e.g. DejaVuSans12bw_bwfont or builtin5x7.

scroll.name: Scroll
scroll.description: Run destination and intermediate stop through instead of shrinking them. The box stays put. Audibly noisy.

step.name: Step
step.description: Pixels per step. Only applies while scrolling.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Delay between steps. Only applies while scrolling.

repeat.name: Repeats
repeat.description: How often the text runs. Only applies while scrolling.

duration.description: How long the message stays before the display returns to normal operation.

priority.description: Higher priority replaces a running message.

draw.name: Draw raw image
draw.description: Writes a complete framebuffer: 16 lines, X = dot on, space = dot off.

fluid.name: Fluid simulation
fluid.description: Pours, sloshes or rains water across the display. Every simulation ends with an empty board (or just the text).

device_id.name: Display
device_id.description: Which Flipdot display to target. Applies to all if omitted.

simulation.name: Simulation
simulation.description: Which simulation. Defaults to the one selected in the fluid simulation dropdown.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Total length of the animation. The whole story always plays; a shorter duration plays it faster.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Time between frames. Flip dots are mechanical - below about 0.15 s the board may not keep up.

text.name: Text
text.description: Optional text. It stays readable (inverted) inside the water and remains at the end; when pulling the plug, water gets caught in the letters.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Fixes the randomness, so the same seed plays exactly the same animation.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Higher priority replaces a running message.

show_page.name: Show page
show_page.description: Immediately shows a page defined in fluepdot_pages.yaml.

extract_fonts.name: Measure fonts
extract_fonts.description: Renders every character once on the board and measures the glyphs, so Home Assistant can typeset the same fonts itself. Takes several minutes and is audibly noisy.

set_rendering_timings.name: Set timings
set_rendering_timings.description: Sets the per-column drive timings. Values that are too short leave dots stuck.
